Priya: Heads up — our access-evidence ingestion for the access-cert pipeline lagged in the last scheduled batch. ~12% of owners show as 'unknown' in the UI. Anyone else seeing this?
Sam: Yep, saw alerts. evidence-ingest returned 502/503 during the 03:30 UTC batch window.
Alex: Is this the v2 consumer or the legacy pipeline? We rolled a schema tweak last Thurs.
Priya: v2 consumer. I suspect the mapping change we shipped (owner_id rename) might be the culprit.
sec-bot: Alert: evidence-ingest spike detected (503s) 03:29–03:36 UTC. PD: oncall Matt.
Matt: Oncall here — can you drop a sample error or owner id and I'll start a quick triage?
Sam: Sample error from consumer logs: `KeyError: 'owner_id'` in evidence_mapper.py at line 78. Also saw truncated manifest errors from s3-consumer around same time.
Priya: I repro'd locally — mapping failed when payload had legacy `owner` object instead of `owner_id` string. I pushed a permissive mapper to staging that accepts both shapes and normalizes to owner_id.
Alex: Good. For prod we should avoid in-place fixes that mutate historical records. Recommend: 1) canary backfill to reconciliation table, 2) compare diffs, 3) if OK, run throttled backfill to primary table. Also add a quick schema-compat check before ingest.
Sam: I'll add a loghook and extra metric (ingest.normalize.missing_owner -> increment) so we can gate on the canary. Also will add code to mark missing owner as `service:unknown` so least-priv checks don't break evaluation jobs.
Priya: Plan proposal (owner: Priya):
- Tonight 00:30 UTC: run a canary backfill (10k records) with `--dry-run` writing to `access_evidence_recon`
- Review diffs and run spot-checks against KMS-access logs and audit-log correlation
- If canary <0.5% diff/unexpected, do throttled full backfill (rate 100/s) with automatic pausing on error >1%
- After backfill, create audit ticket with evidence and hashes for attestation
Any objections?
Alex: SGTM. Add a rollback: if any consumer 5xxs recur or PD triggers, abort job and revert to pre-backfill checkpoint.
Matt: I'll be oncall for the window and will monitor PD, error budget, and KMS latency metrics. Ping me `@Matt` if it spikes.
Sam: Also: check KMS permission errors — last month we had brief KMS timeouts that caused downstream `None` owner cases. Metrics show KMS latency normal today but I'll keep an eye.
Priya: I'll schedule the canary and add the dry-run output to the ticket. I'll also include a short runbook for rollback steps and the query to identify affected services.
Alex: One more thing — add the audit-log entry for each record the backfill changes: `user=svc-evidence-backfill action=normalize old_owner=... new_owner=... trace_id=...` so acct team can verify.
Priya: Will do.
Matt: Cool. If anything goes weird during the canary I'll call an immediate freeze and we'll run a scoped postmortem. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks team — I'll post the canary start time + ticket link when scheduled.
Sam: I'll push the extra metric + temp loghook in a patch to the consumer — should be ready ~20m.
sec-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window tonight 00:30–02:30 UTC recorded for evidence-backfill.
Priya: Posted ticket: https://go/redwood/tickets/SEC-4521 (canary artifacts & dry-run logs).
